blockingFindings.title: R1 freshness coverage only exercises scenario-validity boundary
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local coverage for two of the three required artifact types.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests classify pre-rewind and exact-boundary artifacts as stale only for `scenario-validity-result.json`. R1 requires the same strictly-later-than-`rewoundAt` freshness rule for existing `scenario-validity`, `test-execute`, and `test-result-review` artifacts.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local assertions that `test-execute-result.json` and `test-result-review.json` at or before the latest `rewoundAt` are treated as stale and excluded from current readiness/mechanical validation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local coverage for two of the three required artifact types.

blockingFindings.title: R2 does not cover stale test-execute readiness evidence
blockingFindings.rationale: A required failure path for stale test-execute evidence has no regression test.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires stale `scenario-validity` or `test-execute` evidence to produce `IMPLEMENT_COMPLETION_VALIDATION_FAILED` with `durable-artifact-stale` when no eligible readiness artifact remains. The current stale-evidence failure test covers only `scenario-validity-result.json`.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a fixture where `test-execute-result.json` is the only readiness evidence, its mtime is at or before `rewoundAt`, and completion fails with `IMPLEMENT_COMPLETION_VALIDATION_FAILED` plus `durable-artifact-stale`.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A required failure path for stale test-execute evidence has no regression test.

blockingFindings.title: R3 does not prove stale readiness evidence cannot substitute for current evidence
blockingFindings.rationale: The test suite misses the required non-substitution behavior and could pass an implementation that incorrectly accepts stale readiness evidence.
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test verifies stale downstream artifacts do not block when current scenario evidence exists, but it does not verify that stale retained `test-execute` evidence cannot satisfy readiness when no current readiness artifact exists.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a test with stale retained `test-execute-result.json` and no current `scenario-validity` or current `test-execute` readiness artifact, asserting completion does not pass by using the stale artifact.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The test suite misses the required non-substitution behavior and could pass an implementation that incorrectly accepts stale readiness evidence.

blockingFindings.title: R4 preservation coverage is incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: Multiple explicit acceptance cases in R4 have no spec-local coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: R4 requires no-rewind preservation for missing evidence, incomplete requirements, incomplete file-map entries, valid scenario-validity or test-execute evidence, raw output presence, and all three producer completion adapters. The current no-rewind test covers valid scenario evidence and incomplete requirements only.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add no-rewind tests or assertions for missing evidence, incomplete file-map entries, valid test-execute evidence, raw output presence handling, and the three producer completion adapters.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Multiple explicit acceptance cases in R4 have no spec-local coverage.
